card.fires_on: The digit 1 (or 3) right after a section number like '2.' or an opening parenthesis, where a new numbered heading such as 2.1 Recommended Dosage begins. Also fires on the space before a number in tables.

modes.description: The '1' in the heading number 2.1 that opens the dosage subsection after a summary of cross-references.

modes.label: Numbered list item
modes.description: A digit inside parentheses starting a new numbered paragraph in a regulation.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space just before a strength or percentage figure in a table or dose list.
